blocks.content: The Governing Council is the highest decision-making body of NITI Aayog. It includes the Chief Ministers of all states, Lieutenant Governors of Union Territories, and is chaired by the Prime Minister.
The Governing Council is the highest decision-making body of NITI Aayog.

items: Remember that the Governing Council is chaired by the Prime Minister, not the Finance Minister or Vice-Chairperson.
Note that both Chief Ministers of States and Lieutenant Governors of Union Territories are ex-officio members.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The Governing Council is the apex decision-making body of NITI Aayog.
The Prime Minister serves as the Chairperson of the Governing Council.
It comprises the Chief Ministers of all Indian states.
Lieutenant Governors of Union Territories are also included as members.
